_doc: The outside of the ship while it lies in the space dock (openspec/changes/deck-pipeline, design section 13b; read by sc-core::exterior::ExteriorData). Directions are ship coordinates: +x port, +y up, +z the bow; any length. Colours are sRGB 0-1. The sky program (crates/sc-render/shaders/sky.glsl) draws the stars, the sun and the planet from them; deckc builds the dock's girders from `dock` into the deck file, and the client draws the bow camera's view onto every viewscreen from `viewscreen`.

planet._doc: A planet below the ship to port, filling a good part of the port windows: its centre's direction and the angle its disc spans from the centre to the limb.

stars._doc: density: the share of grid cells that hold a star (three grids of 3 sizes); brightness: the brightest star's value.

dock._doc: A frame of steel girders round the hull (the Tern is 84 m long, 24.4 m across and 13.8 m high): ring frames every ring_spacing_m along z, longitudinal girders at the corners and mid sides, cross braces on the sides, and a work light at each ring's inner corners. Built by deckc into compartments of the deck `outside`, each within one bay so its vertices stay in the deck vertex's +/-32 m.

viewscreen._doc: The bow camera: where it sits (just ahead of the hull's bow), the way it looks (ahead, turned a little to port and down so the planet's limb is in the corner), its vertical field of view and the target it renders into each frame, pixels.
